milestones.name: Map Function Unlocked
milestones.note: The map is not available at the start; it is unlocked later in the game. New routes only appear after returning to a Network Gate (Hollow Knight style).

milestones.name: Hairpin Grapple Unlocked
milestones.note: Unlocked around 3 hours into the game.

milestones.name: Gliding Unlocked
milestones.note: Unlocked around 8 hours into the game.

milestones.name: Overseer Found
milestones.note: Finding an Overseer entity enables fast travel between areas of The Vessel.

milestones.name: Damaged Robot Repaired
milestones.note: Repairing damaged robots grants valuable bonuses and reveals ship lore.

zones.name: The Vessel
zones.fingerprintHint: The overarching setting/ship of the game; interconnected with many secrets off the main path.
zones.note: The entire game world. Max health reduction mechanic is tied to narrative progression representing the ship's deterioration.

zones.name: Network Gate
zones.fingerprintHint: Save point location; returning here updates the map with newly explored routes.
zones.note: Functions as a save point. Required to update map with newly explored areas, similar to Hollow Knight's bench mechanic.

abilities.name: Hairpin Grapple
abilities.note: Unlocked approximately 3 hours into the game; a major early mobility milestone.

abilities.name: Gliding
abilities.note: Unlocked approximately 8 hours into the game; second major mobility milestone.

abilities.name: Map Function
abilities.note: Not available at game start. Once unlocked, newly explored routes only appear upon returning to a Network Gate.

abilities.name: Aerial Combat Jump Reset
abilities.grants: Chaining hits in the air resets jumps
abilities.note: Core mechanic for both combat and platforming; must be mastered early.

bosses.name: Bosses (general)
bosses.note: Bosses do not summon large numbers of extra mobs. Each death to a boss makes it slightly weaker in Corrupted Boss Mode. Boss runbacks can be brutal, requiring repetition of long paths.

objectives.name: Find Overseers
objectives.hopDescription: Locate Overseer entities scattered throughout The Vessel to unlock fast travel between areas.
objectives.note: Without Overseers, traversal requires lengthy backtracking.

objectives.name: Unlock the Map Function
objectives.hopDescription: Progress far enough in the game to unlock the map; rely on memory and exploration until then.

objectives.name: Repair Damaged Robots
objectives.hopDescription: Interact with and repair damaged robots found throughout The Vessel for bonuses and lore.

objectives.name: Convert Nacre to Solid Nacre
objectives.hopDescription: Find robots that convert Nacre to Solid Nacre and use them regularly to prevent resource loss on death.

objectives.name: Unlock Hairpin Grapple
objectives.hopDescription: Progress through approximately 3 hours of gameplay to acquire the Hairpin Grapple ability.

objectives.name: Unlock Gliding
objectives.hopDescription: Progress through approximately 8 hours of gameplay to acquire the Gliding ability.

connectors.description: Returning to a Network Gate (save point) updates the map with newly explored routes.
connectors.note: Network Gates are save points within The Vessel; map sync requires physical return to one.
